description: List GitHub Discussions from Canton Network and Digital Asset repositories cached by CCPEDIA, sorted by recency (newest first). Filter by repo or category, or call with no filter to see which repos are present. CANTON-ONLY and read from CCPEDIA's cache, NOT the live GitHub API or the user's own repos (use a GitHub MCP for those). This is GitHub Discussions: distinct from the Canton web forum (get_discussion) and the sync.global mailing lists (list_mailing_threads). Use get_github_discussion for full body + comments.

limit.description: How many discussions to return, newest first. Default 15, max 50.

repo.description: Filter by owner/name as shown in the unfiltered listing. Repos get transferred, so read the value from a result rather than assuming one.

name: list_github_discussions
